baslik: 31 activists injured during Israeli interception of Gaza-bound aid flotilla: Global Sumud
metin:
At least 31 activists sustained injuries when Israel intercepted the Global Sumud Flotilla in international waters near Crete, approximately 600 nautical miles from Gaza. The activists came from numerous countries including New Zealand, Australia, Italy, the US, Canada, the Netherlands, Spain, the UK, Colombia, Germany, Hungary, Ukraine, France, Poland, and Portugal.

According to the flotilla committee, 'activists detained during the interception were subjected to ill-treatment aboard an Israeli naval vessel for nearly 40 hours.' Detainees experienced deprivation of adequate provisions and sanitation. The statement documents instances where resistance to certain detentions resulted in force deployment by soldiers.

The flotilla departed Barcelona on April 12 and Sicily on April 26, intending to breach Israel's blockade of Gaza. The article notes Israel has maintained this blockade since 2007, and references a two-year military campaign beginning October 2023 that reportedly caused significant casualties and destruction.
yazar: Zeynep Katre Oran (Writing by Seyit Kurt from Istanbul)
